name: dsh-local-delegate
description: Delegate mechanical text work (translate, summarize, extract, classify, rewrite) to a local cheap model endpoint — Ollama native API or any OpenAI-compatible gateway — so the main model stops spending tokens on low-value text transformations. v0.3 adds a Web GUI configuration page (Plugins → Configure and Settings → Local model) with connection tests, model discovery, fallback editing, Subagent route registration, and savings statistics.
